fields.description: The EMR release version associated with the application. ReleaseLabel like emr-6.2.0 ,emr-6.2.1, emr-6.3.0 etc

fields.description: The type of application you want to start, such as Spark or Hive.

fields.name: applicationSetupOptions
fields.value: Use default settings for batch jobs only
optionsArray: Use default settings for batch jobs only
optionArrayDescription: Get started with default application settings when you submit batch jobs.
Specify all application settings such as pre-initialized capacity, network connections, and custom images.
fields.title: Application setup options
fields.description: Application setup options

fields.name: preInitializedDriverCapacity
fields.title: Pre-initialized capacity(DRIVER)
fields.description: Configure pre-initialized capacity to create a warm pool of workers that can respond in seconds. If workers are available, job workloads can start running immediately. Charges apply for each worker once the application starts.

fields.name: preInitializedExecutorCapacity
fields.title: Pre-initialized capacity(EXECUTOR)
fields.description: Configure pre-initialized capacity to create a warm pool of workers that can respond in seconds. If workers are available, job workloads can start running immediately. Charges apply for each worker once the application starts.

fields.name: applicationLimits
fields.title: Application limits
fields.description: Application limits define the maximum CPU, memory, and storage resources that all concurrently running jobs can consume.

fields.name: applicationBehavior
fields.title: Application behavior
fields.description: Allows your application to automatically stop after it's idle for a specified period of time. The default value is set to 15 minutes.
optionsArray: Automatically stop after application is idle for
optionArrayDescription: Automatically stop after application is idle for (Maximum: 360 minutes)

fields.name: managedPersistenceMonitoringConfiguration
fields.title: Allow AWS to retain logs for 30 days
fields.description: Amazon EMR securely stores your logs for a maximum of 30 days. This option also allows Amazon EMR to troubleshoot submitted jobs on your behalf.

fields.name: encryptionConfiguration
fields.title: Encryption key for AWS managed storage
fields.description: Protects your application logs with encryption using your AWS KMS key.

fields.name: s3MonitoringConfiguration
fields.title: Upload logs to your Amazon S3 bucket
fields.description: Store logs in your Amazon S3 bucket. Choose this option if you need to set custom log retention policies or need to enforce custom security policies for application logs. This option limits Amazon EMR’s ability to troubleshoot submitted jobs on your behalf.

fields.name: s3MonitoringConfigurationSettings
optionsArray: Encryption key for Amazon S3 storage location
optionArrayDescription: The Amazon S3 bucket location to store your application logs.
Protects your application logs with encryption using your AWS KMS key.

fields.name: cloudWatchLoggingConfiguration
fields.title: Deliver logs to Amazon CloudWatch
fields.description: Choose this option if you need logs to be delivered to Amazon CloudWatch where you can set your own retention policies or analyze logs with CloudWatch Logs Insights. You should adjust your retention policy for each log group as needed.

fields.name: cloudWatchLoggingConfigurationSettings
optionsArray: Encryption key for Amazon CloudWatch log support
optionArrayDescription: The log group address can have up to 512 characters (alphanumeric, underscore, hyphen, and period).
The log stream prefix can have up to 512 characters (alphanumeric, underscore, hyphen, and period).
By default, Amazon EMR encrypts your logs. This option offers additional protection in Amazon CloudWatch from your AWS KMS key.

fields.name: prometheusMonitoringConfiguration
fields.title: Deliver engine metrics to Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus
fields.description: Choose this option to deliver detailed Spark engine metrics to Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus to monitor your applications.

fields.name: remoteWriteUrl
fields.title: Remote write URL
fields.description: Enter the remote write URL from your Workspace on Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus
